Naomi Siolo

Naomi Siolo is a solo Christian pop singer and songwriter. Starting by sharing original songs online, Naomi blends uplifting melodies with heartfelt lyrics that reflect her faith. What she does: writes all of her music independently, creating inspiring Christian pop songs that encourage hope, worship, and a deeper connection with God.

Mia Herak

Mia Herak is a powerful gospel singer whose incredibly strong and soulful vocals captivate audiences with every performance. Blending passionate melodies with heartfelt faith, Mia's music centers on God, hope, and sharing the message of Jesus through song. What she does: writes and performs inspiring gospel music that combines uplifting lyrics, rich harmonies, and emotional storytelling, creating a moving experience that encourages and strengthens listeners in their faith.

Matilda Burns

Matilda Burns creates heartfelt slow-pop ballads that blend gentle melodies with powerful messages of faith. Through her reflective songwriting and emotional vocals, Matilda shares stories of hope, grace, and her relationship with Jesus, inviting listeners into moments of worship and encouragement. What she does: writes, records, and performs inspiring Christian pop ballads, crafting sincere songs that combine touching lyrics, warm piano arrangements, and uplifting themes centered on faith in Christ.

Tadhg Jones

Tadhg Jones reimagines contemporary guitar music through a laid-back fusion of lo-fi textures and jazz-inspired improvisation. What he does: Using smooth electric guitar tones, mellow chord progressions, and subtle atmospheric effects, Tadhg crafts relaxing instrumental soundscapes that blend the warmth of jazz with the nostalgic character of lo-fi music, creating immersive performances that feel both intimate and timeless.
